command_templates.name: parse_hives
command_templates.when: When parsing offline user Registry hives and outputting to CSV.

usage_description: SBECmd is used for parsing NTUSER.dat and UsrClass.dat registry hives to extract folder traversal artifacts, which can be useful in both law enforcement and private sector investigations.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: FirstInteracted timestamp indicates initial access to a directory.
suspicious_indicators.description: This may indicate the first time a user accessed a specific folder.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: LastInteracted timestamp indicates last access to a directory.
suspicious_indicators.description: This may indicate the most recent time a user accessed a specific folder.

known_false_positives: SBECmd output can be influenced by system timezone settings and transaction logs, which might lead to misinterpretation of timestamps if not properly accounted for.
